patterns.candidate: Technical mechanism may need translation for this reader
Broad benefit may conceal the actual capability
Proof or urgency needs a real source
Offer condition or CTA must match the destination
Internal state or exception may have leaked into UI text
Cause, data retention, or staffed response needs verification
patterns.regex: \b(?:check your (?:internet|connection)|your (?:work|data|draft) is safe|we(?:'|’)re (?:looking into|investigating)|our team has been notified)\b
\b(?:cannot be undone|can(?:'|’)t be undone|permanently delet(?:e|ed)|undo (?:anytime|at any time)|recover (?:anytime|at any time))\b

patterns.candidate: Canned contrast may replace a useful distinction
Praise or intensifier may lack substance
Stock introduction or conclusion may add no information
patterns.regex: \b(?:in today(?:'|’)s (?:fast[- ]paced|digital|ever[- ]evolving) world|in conclusion|at the end of the day|it(?:'|’)s worth noting|ultimately)\b
